notes: THIS IS A TEST TOKEN, NOT A REAL COIN: it has no value and must not be bought. Logo: https://www.si-md.xyz/logo.jpg. TestToken (src/TestToken.sol) is a plain ERC-20 with no constructor arguments that mints its fixed supply once to its deployer, the launch factory; no transfer tax, no mint/burn. TestHook (src/TestHook.sol) is the Uniswap v4 hook for the SIMDTEST2/IMD pool (LP fee 12500, tickSpacing 60, hooks = this hook). Constructor (IPoolManager manager_, address token_) = ($poolManager, $token); it binds the pool id of the sorted token/IMD key and validates its address flags (low 14 bits 0x20cc: beforeInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta, matching getHookPermissions). On every buy and sell it takes 0.75% (75/10000) of the gross executed IMD side, kept in IMD and never swapped for ETH, paid to the SIMD Test Vault 0xa9d495a0b10ee4a2a735c2e0f6d38c583194813a (a constant). Exact-input buys and exact-output sells charge via the beforeSwap specified delta, previewing the fill with a self-only always-reverting quote so unfilled IMD is not taxed; the other directions charge via the afterSwap unspecified delta. The fee is paid with poolManager.take to the vault; if that take fails (e.g. the manager lacks IMD balance) the hook mints itself an ERC-6909 IMD claim instead so the swap never reverts, and anyone can call flushFees() to redeem claims to the fixed vault. With the factory's 1.25% LP fee a trade costs 2% nominal. No owner, admin, setters, pause, blacklist, upgrade path, anti-sniper tax, or time/block logic: every address and rate is fixed at deploy, so the hook takes no $owner, $factory or $launchNumber argument. beforeInitialize is PoolManager-only, accepts only the bound pool key (fee 12500) and any initializer and opening price, and returns its selector. The hook declares no liquidity callbacks, so the factory's zero-liquidity fee collection is unaffected.
